# Genjutsu Studio (https://genjutsu-trends.com/)

> Make viral AI video trends with your own photos, in the browser. Pick a trend, upload a photo for each part, and Higgsfield's Genjutsu model puts you in the scene. Pay per video, no subscription, no app.

Last updated: 2026-10-28. Independent site: not affiliated with or endorsed by Higgsfield AI.

## Pricing
- From $2.50 per video (Budget mode / Genjutsu Light, 480p). Premium mode and 720p/1080p cost more.
- 100 credits = $1, credits never expire, failed or blocked renders are refunded automatically.
- Full price list: https://genjutsu-trends.com/pricing/
